title.narrative: UNICEF actively participated in discussions and dialogues around the need to establish a nation-wide care system, which is a key policy priority in the country. Specifically, UNICEF highlighted the importance to expand quality childcare, prioritizing poor and vulnerable families without social security coverage, which provided the government with first-hand evidence and concrete proposals to start building this care system, with focus on children.
